data.name: Pressure Express
data.detailed_description:
The world has drowned, and its scattered settlements depend on Pressure Express.

You and up to three friends play as Delivery Droids operating a submarine delivery service. Choose your route, transport valuable cargo, and keep every package safe from crushing pressure, extreme temperatures, flooding, fires, and deep-sea hazards.

Work together to navigate, operate machinery, manage oxygen and fuel, pump out water, and repair the submarine before everything falls apart. Each cargo type requires special care, so one careless mistake or one careless coworker can ruin the delivery.

Complete missions, earn rewards, upgrade your operation, and venture into more dangerous waters. Keep your reviews high and meet the company quota, or prepare to be fired and rebooted.

Deliver under pressure. Survive the chaos. Laugh through the mess.

data.short_description: Pressure Express is a 1–4 player co-op party roguelite where delivery droids operate a submarine, manage failing systems, protect temperamental cargo, and survive the dangers of a flooded world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit, version 21H1 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Steam client and internet connection required for multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Steam client and internet connection required for multiplayer.
